campaign_mailing_id.description: UUID string, can be retrieved from the id= part of the URL when editing a marketing email

sender_email.description: Email for a Paubox Marketing user to track who sent it. This is NOT the "From email" that will be used to send the message

subscription_list_id.description: UUID string, can be retrieved from the listId= part of the URL of any Contact List page

recipient_emails.description: Optional - will send preview message equivalent (no smart text replacements)

customer_name.description: Optional for footer. Leave empty to use default information

from_email.description: Optional - the email the user will see the email is sent from. Leave empty to use default information

from_name.description: Optional - the name the user will see the email is from. Leave empty to use default information

subject.description: Optional - the subject of the email. Will use the marketing email unique ID if not specified
